title: SEOHEAD Evidence Reporting Pack (Synthetic)
source_mode: one Google Sheet worksheet per BI dataset

pages.title: Optional Search Console and Analytics evidence

calculated_fields.name: is_measured_zero
calculated_fields.formula: CASE WHEN value_state = 'measured' AND value_number = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

calculated_fields.name: observed_inlink_share_label
calculated_fields.formula: CONCAT(CAST(numerator AS TEXT), '/', CAST(denominator AS TEXT))

filter_rules: Never coerce blank numeric cells to zero; retain state and reason fields in every table and chart tooltip.
Use source-specific date controls for metrics and display period_start, period_end and timezone beside every performance chart.
Show inlink percentages only with numerator, denominator and extraction_coverage_state.
Do not blend Search Console clicks or impressions with GA sessions; the quadrant is an evidence-qualified URL cohort, not a summed metric.
